Subject: Post-call: Leadership readout & procurement path — AvaPharma

Hi Claire / Tom,

Thanks again for a focused discussion today. Below is a short readout for your leadership team and the procurement track we discussed. Please flag anything I missed.

Key pain points you confirmed:
- Unpredictable per-request latency at high concurrency (p95 ~800–900ms today)
- Token cost spiking during batch inference and burst workloads
- Need for strict data locality and auditability for R&D patient data

Stated goals / success criteria:
- Move to p95 < 300ms for core generative endpoints under expected Q1 load
- Reduce per-token cost by ~35% vs current provider (pilot baseline)
- Operate in a VPC/private deployment or approved cloud region with KMS audit logs

Procurement path (high level):
1) Technical pilot (4–6 weeks) — scope: 50k requests/day sandbox; include KV caching and batching config
2) Security review & evidence (SOC2, encryption, audit logs) — parallel to pilot
3) Commercial review & PO — target decision / PO by end of Q1

Immediate asks / next steps (owners):
- Ben (me): Share pilot proposal + ballpark pricing (attached) — by EOD today
- Karthik: Draft pilot success criteria & test plan — by 11/15
- Marissa: Prepare commercial template and early pricing options (pilot vs annual commit)
- Claire/Tom: Loop in procurement (name/contact) and leadership readout slot — target week of 11/18

Attachments: RWD-pilot-proposal.pdf (pilot scope & pricing)

Suggested next meeting: Exec readout with Claire, Tom and their procurement lead on 2025-11-19. Happy to shift — let me know what works.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | +1-415-555-0124

Ben —

Appreciate the concise summary. This captures the conversation well. I've looped in Samir (procurement) — Samir, please meet Ben (Redwood) and Karthik/Marissa from the team — they'll be handling pilot & commercial details.

A few clarifications from our side:
- Data residency: we will likely require data to remain in our US-only cloud tenancy or an on-prem option if required by legal. Can Redwood support a VPC/private control plane + HSM/KMS? Please confirm.
- Pilot scale: 50k/day is in the ballpark; we want the pilot to include a synthetic load test that mimics peak hour concurrency.
- Pricing: can you provide a 'no commitment' pilot price and a follow-on committed rate for annual purchase (with conversion credits)?

I attached our vendor evaluation template — please fill the sections relevant to security and deployment options.

Available for the exec readout on 11/19 at 10:30am ET.
